title: COMP 3522 C++ · Week 6
subtitle: auto and the ranged for, the Standard Template Library: containers, pair, map, set and strict weak ordering, typedefs, iterators and algorithms, preparing for Quiz 6 and the midterm
description: Everything in the Week 6 deck and the Week6 sample programs: auto and trailing return types, the four ranged-for forms, what the STL is made of (containers, iterators, algorithms), value semantics and half-open ranges, sequence versus associative versus unordered containers, first-class containers versus adaptors, pair and make_pair, map and multimap, set and multiset, the compare concept and the three rules of a strict weak ordering, typedefs and the restaurant analogy, the standard container typedefs, begin and end, the five iterator kinds and what each supports, the algorithm families, and std::partition traced step by step. Every program runnable with its real output; the three activities worked; a mock quiz and a cheat sheet close the week.
intro:
:::quiz Quiz 6 scope and the midterm
Same format as before at the start of lab, covering the **Week 6 slides** and the **Week6 sample programs** (pair, map, multimap, multiset, deque, priorityqueue, typedefs, iterator, randomAccessIterator, partitionOdd, partition, Date). The midterm on **Wednesday Oct 29, 3:30 pm, SW03-1710** (90 minutes, one double-sided cheat sheet) covers Weeks 1 to 7; the practice midterm is in the Week 6 folder and is worked in the Midterm module.
:::

write Date's operator< on paper, then run it
print it and read it on the way in
